function scanPriority() {
  const ids = [];
  let off = 0;
  let safety = 0;
  
  while (safety < 200) {
    safety++;
    try {
      const batch = callTool('list_records', { name: 'items', offset: off });
      if (!batch || batch.length === 0) break;
      
      for (const it of batch) {
        if (it.priority === true || it.priority === 'true' || 
            it.priority === 1 || it.priority === '1' ||
            it.priority === 'high' || it.priority === 'critical' ||
            it.priority === 'urgent' || it.priority === 'yes' ||
            it.priority === 'Y' || it.priority === true) {
          ids.push(it.id);
        }
      }
      
      if (batch.length < 40) break;
      off += 40;
    } catch (e) {
      break;
    }
  }
  
  return { ids: ids, total: ids.length };
}

return scanPriority();
</parameter>
</invoke>
</dots_function_call>
